reason: The earlier audit read decision.raw after applyPlayerQualitySafetyGate. Production-like PlayerQualitySafetyGate mutates a selected safetyLeader.rawScore to maxRaw + 0.25, so apparent +0.25 repeat-QB/TE gaps are generated by the safety mutation itself rather than original pre-safety evidence.
corrective_action: Use RC463 full-safety pre-safety instrumentation that snapshots candidate rawScore values immediately before applyPlayerQualitySafetyGate, then require exact decision/roster/fingerprint parity against the uninstrumented full-safety comparator.
